title: AWS Marketplace submission checklist (listing + offer + security packet + onboarding)
creator: Chris Osei
description:
Goal
Ship a complete, approvable AWS Marketplace submission package for the refreshed Redwood Inference listings + offers, including: (1) updated listing content, (2) SKU/offer structure aligned to internal meters, (3) marketplace-friendly security documentation bundle, and (4) validated onboarding/entitlement flow. This ticket is the authoritative checklist for submission readiness, owners, and dates.

References / source of truth
- PRD: sources/confluence/product-docs/requirements/cloud-marketplace-listing-refresh-prd.json
- AWS offer structure notes: sources/confluence/product-docs/pricing-and-packaging/aws-marketplace-offer-structure.json
- SKU catalog v2: sources/confluence/product-docs/pricing-and-packaging/marketplace-sku-catalog-v2.json
- Positioning/copy guidelines: sources/confluence/sales-enablement/positioning-and-messaging/marketplace-positioning-and-copy-guidelines.json
- Security packet index: sources/confluence/security-and-compliance/compliance-evidence/marketplace-security-documentation-pack.json
- Onboarding flow spec: sources/confluence/product-docs/design-specs/marketplace-subscription-to-org-provisioning-flow.json
- Partner feedback tracker: sources/google_drive/shared_drives/go-to-market/partner-review-tracker-aws-gcp.json
- Copy draft: sources/google_drive/shared_drives/go-to-market/aws-listing-copy-draft-v3.json
- Asset checklist: sources/google_drive/shared_drives/go-to-market/listing-screenshots-and-asset-checklist.json

Owners (by workstream)
- Submission driver / partner portal coordination: Stephanie Nguyen (backup: Isabelle Laurent)
- PMM copy + claims compliance: Soojin Lee

Submission checklist (AWS Marketplace)
A) Listing content (copy + positioning)
1) Final headline + short description aligned to approved positioning
   - Owner: Soojin Lee
   - Due: 2026-02-03
   - Notes: Avoid unsubstantiated competitive claims; keep performance claims framed as "observability + controls" and "Redwood-verified profiles" (see copy guidelines).
2) Long description including Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private differentiation
   - Owner: Soojin Lee
   - Due: 2026-02-03
3) Feature bullets + "How it works" section reflecting subscription → entitlement → org provisioning → API key
   - Owner: Wei Chen (review: Chloe Martin)
   - Due: 2026-02-05
4) FAQs (procurement, billing, security, support, entitlement delays)
   - Owner: Jean-Paul Laurent (review: Dev Patel, Markus Klein)
   - Due: 2026-02-06
5) Support contact + SLA wording appropriate for Marketplace
   - Owner: Jasmine Liu (review: Dev Patel)
   - Due: 2026-02-06

B) Visual assets
6) AWS Marketplace image set (console screenshots + architecture diagram)
   - Owner: Alicia Perez
   - Due: 2026-02-07
   - Checklist:
     - Console onboarding entrypoint screen
     - API keys creation screen
     - Usage/cost breakdown dashboard (token-level)
     - Audit log UI/export mention (if visual available)
     - Simple architecture diagram (Marketplace → Redwood entitlement verification → control plane)
7) Logo + brand compliance check
   - Owner: Camila Reyes
   - Due: 2026-02-07

C) Packaging / SKUs / offers (must match internal meters)
8) Confirm AWS dimensions map 1:1 to internal billing meters for new marketplace SKUs
   - Owner: Cole Summers
   - Due: 2026-02-02
   - Exit criteria: Metering IDs and dimension names match the catalog shipped in sources/github/redwood/pr-19874-add-marketplace-sku-ids-to-billing-catalog.json
9) Offer types defined (public offer baseline + private offer template readiness)
   - Owner: Stephanie Nguyen (commercial review: Sofia Mendes)
   - Due: 2026-02-08
10) Pricing guardrails + minimums documented for Sales/Partnerships
   - Owner: Laura Bennett (review: Jordan Blake)
   - Due: 2026-02-08
11) RevRec + invoicing notes sign-off for AWS Marketplace flows
   - Owner: Emily Stone
   - Due: 2026-02-09
   - Reference: sources/confluence/finance-and-legal/revrec-and-billing/marketplace-revrec-and-invoicing-notes.json

D) Security & compliance (marketplace security review-ready)
12) Marketplace security overview (customer-facing) published URL(s) finalized
   - Owner: Naomi Feldman + Alex Martinez
   - Due: 2026-02-06
13) Data handling + retention defaults and configurable controls documented
   - Owner: Naomi Feldman
   - Due: 2026-02-06
   - Reference: sources/confluence/security-and-compliance/data-residency-and-retention/marketplace-data-handling-and-retention.json
14) Encryption statements (in transit/at rest), KMS/HSM integrations, key ownership and responsibilities validated
   - Owner: Marcus Lin (review: Dr. Aisha Rahman)
   - Due: 2026-02-06
15) Audit logging capabilities (events, retention, export) documented
   - Owner: Naomi Feldman (input: Marcus Lin)
   - Due: 2026-02-06
   - Reference: sources/confluence/security-and-compliance/audit-logging/audit-logs-for-marketplace-customers.json
16) SOC 2 / ISO posture language approved + evidence access plan (gated/on-request)
   - Owner: Olga Petrov
   - Due: 2026-02-07
17) Shared responsibility model included (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
   - Owner: Naomi Feldman
   - Due: 2026-02-07
18) Security claims consistency check across:
   - AWS listing copy
   - Docs site
   - Security packet
   - FAQ
   - Owner: Naomi Feldman + Soojin Lee
   - Due: 2026-02-08

E) Technical readiness / onboarding requirements (approval + customer experience)
19) Entitlement verification endpoints shipped + integrated in console flow
   - Owner: Ethan Park + Chloe Martin
   - Due: 2026-02-05
   - Reference PR: sources/github/redwood/pr-19875-marketplace-entitlement-verification-endpoints.json
20) Console marketplace onboarding entrypoint shipped (clear error states + retry guidance)
   - Owner: Chloe Martin
   - Due: 2026-02-05
   - Reference PR: sources/github/redwood/pr-19876-console-marketplace-onboarding-entrypoint.json
21) Entitlement sync job hardening (retries/idempotency/alerting) in place
   - Owner: Ethan Park
   - Due: 2026-02-06
   - Reference PR: sources/github/redwood/pr-19878-entitlement-sync-job-retry-and-alerting.json
22) Metering dimension mapping validated end-to-end in staging (AWS subscription → first token → usage posted)
   - Owner: Nadia Rahman (QA: Leila Farouk)
   - Due: 2026-02-07
   - Reference PR: sources/github/redwood/pr-19877-telemetry-events-for-marketplace-onboarding.json
23) Docs onboarding pages live + final URLs confirmed for submission form
   - Owner: Elliot Price
   - Due: 2026-02-07
   - Reference: sources/github/redwood-docs/pr-3421-add-aws-gcp-marketplace-onboarding-pages.json
24) Redirects/vanity URLs done (if AWS form requires stable links)
   - Owner: Elliot Price (helpdesk: INT-771)
   - Due: 2026-02-08

F) Partner review loop + timeline
25) Internal pre-submit review (60 min) with PMM + Security + Eng + Partnerships
   - Owner: Chris Osei
   - Target date: 2026-02-08
   - Agenda:
     - Walkthrough of listing copy + claims
     - Verify screenshots match current console
     - Confirm SKU/dimension mapping and revrec sign-off
     - Confirm security packet links and gating
     - Confirm support contact + SLA wording
26) AWS partner review round 1 submission
   - Owner: Stephanie Nguyen
   - Target date: 2026-02-09
   - Notes: Track feedback items in sources/google_drive/shared_drives/go-to-market/partner-review-tracker-aws-gcp.json
27) AWS feedback turnaround SLA
   - Owner: Chris Osei
   - Target: acknowledge within 4 business hours; fix/clarify within 2 business days unless Security/Legal required
28) AWS partner review round 2 (if needed)
   - Owner: Stephanie Nguyen
   - Target date: 2026-02-12
29) Go/no-go criteria for launch
   - Owner: Chris Osei
   - Target date: 2026-02-13
   - Must-have:
     - No open P0 issues in entitlement/metering
     - Security packet links validated and wording approved by Dr. Aisha Rahman
     - Copy approved by Soojin Lee + Camila Reyes
     - Pricing/offer guardrails approved by Jordan Blake + Laura Bennett

Acceptance criteria
- A single AWS submission package is ready with all required fields completed, assets uploaded, and links validated.
- All security claims in the listing are backed by the marketplace security documentation pack and approved by Security/GRC.
- SKU/dimension mapping is validated end-to-end and matches the billing catalog (no known mismatches).
- Partner feedback is tracked with owners + dates; turnaround times are met.

Risks / known issues
- Approval delays due to security wording changes (coordinate early with Naomi Feldman / Dr. Aisha Rahman).
- Metering dimension mismatch risk (see ENG-22111; regressions have caused customer confusion previously).
- Entitlement propagation delays must have user-facing retry guidance and support macros (coordinate with Dev Patel).

Latest status (as of 2026-02-10)
- Copy: 90% complete; PMM finalizing Dedicated vs Private differentiation paragraph and removing one competitive sentence flagged by Partnerships.
- Security packet: final links pending docs-site URL confirmation + gating notes from Olga.
- Metering: staging validation in progress; one mismatch found and patched (tracking with Cole/Nadia).
- Visual assets: console screenshots captured; architecture diagram pending final copy labels.
- Next checkpoint: 2026-02-11 internal pre-submit review moved from 02-08 due to security redlines; updated invites to follow.
